question: Does the evidence interface (an answer must quote the documents that state it), learned from demonstrations in every wording style to date, lift not-found to the minimum on a new style while documents and chat hold?
why: confirmation4: documents 127/132 and chat 90/96 passed; not-found 20/24 failed. All four misses presuppose the flight ("I have a flight home from Osaka; tell me when it departs") and L7 answered with the outbound time. Two changes. (1) workspace-documents/3: submit_answer must carry verbatim quotes from the documents it cites, the workspace refuses any quote it cannot find, and only a submitted answer counts; the policy states that a request may assume something the documents do not contain. (2) Experience in every style: generated-train, generated-train-extra and generated-train-styles (the spent development, development2 and confirmation4 wordings, on new workspaces), each demonstrated under version 3. L8 is judged on generated-development3, a fifth style no unit has seen.

unit.name: L8
unit.layers: A2 layers and projections, rank and alpha

experience.documents: verified version-3 demonstrations of 660 generated-train, 90 generated-train-extra and 330 generated-train-styles cases
experience.replay: the parent's own greedy chat replies on the 320 generated-train chat cases (values quoted) under the chat2 policy, replayed only where they pass

training.rule: A2 trainer settings for the low-rank module; terminal step only; no checkpoint selection. 320 steps (L7: 256) for 1,080 demonstrations against 750, so each is seen about as often; mixture and replay are L7's.

integration: parent and parent+L8 greedily on the 66 documents and 48 chat generated-development3 cases on the same GPU; the parent serves under the same version-3 documents policy
next_gate: L8 advances to the sealed confirmation5 on the canonical CPU runtime only if, on generated-development3, it solves more documents cases than the parent, loses no more than one chat case, and every minimum (documents 85%, chat 90%, not-found 90%) holds.
